_about: Pairs the silhouette lint (render/anim/tools/silhouette_lint.gd) does not flag, and the poses it does not compare. overlay: pose-id prefixes that are layered over another pose and never shown alone (only some bones are used), so their silhouette is not a look of its own. pairs: two poses that are meant to look alike (the same idea in two systems), with the reason. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
pairs: the same bracing idea: the cue pose is the brace the director calls for, the other the base state's
